title: The word of faith near you
english: "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart"—that is, the word of faith that we preach. "Because if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved" (Romans 10:8-9).

title: A prayer for hope, joy, and peace
english: But may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit (Romans 15:13). Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
